newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: NEC unit gets Telekom contract.
newsitem.headline: NEC unit gets Telekom contract.

text.p: Japan's NEC Corp said on Thursday that its Malaysian unit has been awarded a contract valued at over 10 billion yen from Telekom Malaysia Bhd to supply public digital switching systems.

The pact, which runs from 1996 through 1998, includes the supply of 700,000 to 800,000 lines of public digital switching systems by NEC's Malaysian unit PERNEC Corp Sdn Bhd, NEC said in a statement released here.
NEC's public switching system NEAX61 will be made by PERNEC in Malaysia and supplied to national telecommunications firm Telekom.
With this contract, NEC's share of the public switching market in Malaysia is about 50 percent, making it the top supplier of the product in the country, NEC said.
NEC said its cumulative orders for public telephone switching in Malaysia now amounts to more than four million lines, with a total value of about 100 billion yen.
